summary: U.S. consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, down from 0.6% in September. Both headline and core inflation exceeded forecasts.

author.name: Stocks To Buy Now AI Research

paragraphs: • Headline CPI rose 0.4% month over month, compared with 0.6% in September and 0.3% expected.
• Core CPI, excluding food and energy, rose 0.3%, compared with 0.2% expected.
• Year-over-year inflation was unavailable because October 2025 data was not collected during the government shutdown.
• Shelter prices increased 0.3%, accounting for over 30% of the monthly headline increase.
• Food prices rose 0.5%; groceries increased 0.4% and dining out increased 0.5%.
• Energy prices increased 0.7%, following a 5.2% rise in September.
• Gasoline prices rose 1.0% and electricity increased 0.9%, while natural gas fell 0.8%.
• Used vehicle prices declined 1.2%, while recreation increased 0.8% and vehicle insurance rose 0.7%.
